title: Dispute Monthly Maintenance and Overdraft Fee
description: Customer notices a $35 overdraft fee and a $12 monthly service fee on their statement and requests a courtesy fee waiver.

customer_profile.name: Marcus Aurelius
customer_profile.context_summary: Customer in good standing for 3 years; zero prior overdraft fee waivers in the trailing 12 months.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, thank you for reaching Apex Bank customer care. How may I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I was checking my online statement and saw a thirty-five dollar overdraft fee charged yesterday. I've been a loyal customer for three years and I want this fee waived.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can certainly look into that fee for you Marcus. Let me check your waiver eligibility.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, will the thirty-five dollars be refunded back to my account today?

expected_summary.call_overview: Customer called requesting a waiver for a $35 overdraft fee on checking account ****7104.
